snippet.title: Sunfarers - a Space Life Simulator - Life Onboard the Ship
snippet.description:
In this trailer, we show you the ship interior vibes you can expect in Sunfarers.

Sunfarers is a space life sim about an interplanetary ship and its crew. 688 years ago, the network of wormholes that connected the galaxy abruptly collapsed. No ship, probe or voice from another star has reached this solar system since. Its six worlds had to get by alone, whilst the stars took on unnatural colors and reality-defying phenomena gnawed at people's sanity. But civilization endured, and crews like yours are the reason why; they brave the void and the dangers of warped space to keep those who remained after the Collapse connected and anchored in reality.

Sunfarers on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4851460/Sunfarers/
